SPY.title: Zelensky Says Ukraine Won't Trade Minerals For Debt, Seeks 'Win-Win' Deal With US
SPY.description: Ukraine's President Zelensky remains focused on security guarantees as the country negotiates a deal with the US over its rare earth minerals. Zelensky is committed to a 'win-win' agreement and has disputed the financial claims made by the Trump administration.
SPY.author: Stjepan Kalinic
